verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party docs cover the whole loop. Marketers compose emails in a drag-and-drop editor with templates, subject line, preview text and sender settings. They pick audiences by including and excluding contacts and segments. They can send immediately or schedule for a specific date and time, including per-recipient time zones. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the compose-target-send loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Once you've created a marketing email, you can edit its content, appearance, and module locations.
You can set the email's subject line and preview text.
You can set contacts and segments who will receive the email, as well as those that won't receive the email, even if they're included on segment you're sending to.
You can send a marketing email immediately or schedule the email to send at a specific date and time.
**Recipient's time zone (varied)**: send at the specified time using the time zones on the contact records of the recipients.
